Subject: Implementation sequencing questionnaire — we need your phased plan

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our RFP appendix C, we need a concise implementation sequencing response that covers: timeline (weeks), integration steps, canary/fallback plan, monitoring KPIs, and abort/rollback criteria. I've attached Appendix C with our exact questionnaire fields.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Production window required: 3pm–11pm PT change freeze for EHR services
- Network: VPC peering preferred; strict egress rules, no public endpoints for PHI
- Compliance: SOC2 in-scope; we will need sample audit logs for the first 90 days

Can you provide a single-sheet phased rollout plan and a short canary safeguard checklist by EOD Thursday 2026-06-18? If you need to split deliverables we can accept a draft timeline first.

Regards,
Aria Quinn
Senior Program Manager, Integrations
Asteria Health Systems

Subject: Re: Implementation sequencing questionnaire — deployment phasing & canary safeguards

Hi Aria — thanks for the details and the appendix. Looping in Rishi (lead Solutions), Laura (integration PM), and Neha (CS/security lead) to help with a short, actionable plan.

Plan for deliverables:
- Draft phased timeline (single sheet): by Thu 2026-06-18 EOD — will include week-by-week gates and owners.
- Canary safeguards checklist (SRE-friendly): same day — includes monitoring windows and abort thresholds.
- Follow-up: 30-minute sync next Mon to review final plan and sign off on network steps.

Initial questions for the questionnaire (quick answers appreciated):
1) Do you require a dedicated private deployment (VPC/on-prem) from day one, or can we start on Dedicated pool with immediate plan to migrate to VPC?
2) Are there hard limits on allowed latency (p95) for the user-facing inference path? If you have an SLA target, please share.
3) Who is the primary security contact for SOC2 evidence requests?

Rishi, Laura — can you take the lead drafting the timeline and canary steps? Neha, please prepare the short list of audit artifacts we can provide for the first 90 days.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Implementation sequencing questionnaire — deployment phasing & canary safeguards

Aria / Jasmine / Team,

Attached is our proposed draft timeline (redwood_migration_timeline_v1.xlsx) and an SRE canary checklist (sre_canary_checklist.txt). Key highlights below — this is written to match your change freeze and VPC preference, but we can adjust.

Executive summary (6-week phased plan):
- Week 0–1 (Preparation): legal/PO, account creation, assign contacts, KMS onboarding, baseline performance test in staging.
- Week 2 (Network + Auth): VPC peering setup, route tables, egress policy review, mTLS between your ingress and our private endpoint; onboarding of API keys and HSM/KMS integration for keys.
- Week 3 (Integration + End-to-end tests): SDK integration, sample payload tests (non-PHI), tokenization and redaction checks, KV-cache warmup, and latency baseline capture.
- Week 4 (Canary 1 — 1% traffic): 24–48h with ramp to 5% if stable; key metrics: p95 latency < 300ms, error rate < 0.5%, token throughput within 10% of planned.
- Week 5 (Canary 2 — 10% traffic): 72h observation window, run pre-defined regression evals on production prompt set, validate cost telemetry and token accounting.
- Week 6 (Full ramp): incremental ramp across zones to 100% with staggered routing (25/40/70/100) over 48–72h. Post-migration stabilization window: 7 days.

Canary/Abort criteria (short):
- Abort immediate and rollback if sustained error rate > 1% for 15m or p95 exceeds 2x baseline for 30m.
- Manual abort for model output regressions flagged by automated evals or CS reports.
- Automatic fallback: traffic re-route to standby compatible model variant in a different region/instance group.

Integration checklist (high-level):
- VPC peering request + allowed CIDR ranges (Asteria to provide)
- Service account and least-privilege IAM role for logs/metrics export
- Tokenization/redaction hooks (client-side) for PHI exclusion
- Schema integration for response payloads (json schema versioning)

Attachments included: redwood_migration_timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), sre_canary_checklist.txt (plain text).

Next steps:
- Aria: confirm VPC preference and CIDR by Friday 6/19.
- Jasmine/Laura: propose Mon 6/21 30-min review slot for owners.
- Neha: will upload the SOC2 artifacts list to the shared Drive by EOD Thu.

Thanks — can expand any section for the final deliverable.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Aria Quinn <aria.quinn@asteriahealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Implementation sequencing questionnaire — deployment phasing & canary safeguards

Thanks Rishi — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick clarifications before the sync:

1) VPC: we will require VPC peering for all traffic containing PHI; for low-risk flows we can start on Dedicated pool and plan a migration to VPC in Week 3. Confirmed.
2) CIDR: sending CIDR ranges in a separate email from NetOps (Tom).
3) SOC2 artifacts: Procurement will work with Neha on a limited set of artifacts (user audit logs, admin changes, and sample retention policy) — prefer those exported via secure Drive link.

One change request: can you shorten the Canary 2 observation window to 48h if all KPIs are green at the end of Canary 1? We need to compress the schedule to meet our internal go-live by end of July.

If Rishi/Laura can confirm that tweak, we will accept the draft and move to the sign-off flow.

Best,
Aria Quinn
Senior Program Manager, Integrations
Asteria Health Systems
